content.text:
I submitted **"Example Domain"**, but it's the page title, not a heading. The page at https://example.com/ doesn't show a main heading. - **What the page shows:** a book icon, the "This domain is for use in documentation examples…" text in six languages, and a "Learn more" link. - **What's missing:** the old `

Example Domain

` no longer appears on the page or in its accessibility tree. "Example Domain" now only appears as the page title. - **Couldn't confirm:** I tried to open the page source on example.com to see if a hidden heading was still there, but this browser doesn't support that. So I don't know whether a hidden heading exists in the markup. If your check is looking for a real heading element rather than the title, it will need updating for the current version of example.com. I didn't use any other websites.
